name: io.github.gegham-khachatryan/quilly-mcp
title: Quilly
description: Read Google Meet transcripts recorded by the Quilly Chrome extension, including the live meeting.

environmentVariables.name: QUILLY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Pairing token. Shown in Chrome under Quilly → Settings → Local agents.

environmentVariables.name: QUILLY_PORT
environmentVariables.description: First localhost port to try. Change it only if you changed the port in Quilly’s settings.
